description: This C# test source file contains unit tests for Orleans framework's one-way method calls, verifying their synchronous completion behavior both from client and grain perspectives, including Task and ValueTask variants, using Xunit framework for testing.

classes.name: OneWayCallTests
classes.description: Contains unit tests for verifying the behavior of Orleans' one-way method calls, including synchronous completion and execution semantics, utilizing Xunit testing framework.

classes.name: SimpleGrainObserver
classes.description: A simple observer implementation used to test notification reception from grains in asynchronous one-way method call tests.

methods.name: OneWayMethodsReturnSynchronously_ViaClient
methods.description: Tests that Orleans one-way methods invoked from a client complete synchronously as tasks.

methods.name: OneWayMethodReturnSynchronously_ViaGrain
methods.description: Verifies that grain-to-grain one-way calls complete immediately from the caller's perspective.

methods.name: OneWayMethodsReturnSynchronously_ViaClient_ValueTask
methods.description: Tests that Orleans one-way methods returning ValueTask complete synchronously when invoked from the client.

methods.name: OneWayMethodReturnSynchronously_ViaGrain_ValueTask
methods.description: Checks that ValueTask based one-way call semantics are maintained in grain-to-grain communication.
